name: zinterp_context_clear_file_frame_stack
description: zInterp_Context::ClearFileFrameStack frees the file-frame array and clears the frame stack state.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4c1960 validates freeing fileFrameStack when non-null, clearing the stack pointer, and always clearing fileFrameCount.
The native smoke verifies populated and empty clear paths leave the frame stack pointer null and count zero.
